body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics showcased its one-touch speakerphone ‘VX5400’ during CES 2008 (Booth #8214, Central Hall, Las Vegas Convention Center).

The VX5400 by LG is a mobile mainstay with a twist. Besides all the mobile essentials, it is Bluetooth-capable, taking advantage of all the wonders of wireless. The VGA camera is great for photos on the fly and its large color display and keypad are unusual and welcome in such a compact design.
The VX5400’s one-touch speakerphone and speaker-independent voice command functions round out the package, and make mobile calling more convenient than ever.
